title: Global Warming Potential
definition: Global Warming Potential (GWP) is a relative measure of how much heat a greenhouse gas (GHG) traps in the atmosphere over a specific time horizon, relative to Carbon Dioxide (CO2).
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding climate policy, carbon accounting, the Kyoto Protocol, and the Paris Agreement's transparency framework.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Global Warming Potential.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of Greenhouse Effect
